open_points.subject: compose_and_prove flow version with unknown referenced records
open_points.text: A05 rule 1 phase 1 says proof checks that "a function node names an existing contract version; an operation node names a binding in status `accepted`" and A05 rule 7 says composition keeps any such version whether or not proven; A16 rule 1 says "A request naming a record that does not exist ... is refused ... never as a proof failure".
open_points.question: If composition payload names an unknown contract_version_id or binding_id, does composition refuse as unknown reference (keeping no flow version), or keep the flow version and return an unproven proof failure at phase 1?
options: Refuse request as unknown reference before proof; keep nothing
Keep flow version and return proof failure at phase 1 for that node reference
open_points.default_guess: Keep flow version and return a phase-1 proof failure (A05-specific behavior for compose/prove).

open_points.subject: resume authority check for `draft-write` elements waiting `service_unreachable`
open_points.text: A14 rule 2 says on resume authority is checked as "its unused approval ... or a grant still active"; A10 rule 1 says "`draft-write` nodes ask nothing at run time" and their authority is flow activation (except resend after `not_applied`).
open_points.question: When resuming a `draft-write` element that is waiting on `service_unreachable` and has neither approval nor grant, should resend proceed under flow-activation authority or be forced into owner approval wait?
options: Proceed under flow activation (no approval/grant needed)
Require owner approval on resume when no approval/grant is present
open_points.default_guess: Proceed under flow activation, except the explicit `not_applied` resend case.

open_points.subject: restart recovery of `in_flight` attempt with non-approval authority
open_points.text: A11 rule 4 says restart recovery "marks the approval the attempt names as its authority `used`"; but M26/A10 allow EffectAttempt authority to be a standing grant or flow activation, not only an approval.
open_points.question: During restart recovery of an `in_flight` attempt whose authority is grant or flow activation, what record transition is required for authority usage?
options: Mark `used` only when authority is an approval; do nothing for grant/flow activation
Treat such attempts as invalid state and fail recovery
Introduce a parallel 'used' state for grant/flow-activation authority
open_points.default_guess: Mark `used` only for approval authority; leave grant/flow-activation records unchanged.
